page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a decorative woodcut ornament in the centre below the text; catchword-like signature "DE IV-" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: ADMONITIONES, ad Subditos.

p.i: Omnis anima potestatibus superemi-nentibus subiecta esto. Non est enim potestas, nisi à Deo. Itaque, quisquis se opponit potestati, ordinationi Dei refistit: Qui autem refistunt, ipsi sibi condemnationem ferent.

main_text.p: Proinde subiecti estote cuilibet humanæ ordinationi, propter DOMINVM.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. The final line "DE IV-" is a catchword at the lower right. Some letters in the italic text are rendered with long-s forms, transcribed as plain s.
